source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of November 2, 2025, we had approximately 33,000 employees worldwide, with approximately 57% in research and development roles.

payroll.label: median of the annual total compensation of all our employees

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: For fiscal 2025, the annual total compensation of our CEO, as reported in the " Fiscal 2025 Summary Compensation Table ," is $205,278,006. The median of the annual total compensation of all our employees is $378,281.

notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2025 (the same year as the head count) is used; the CEO pay ratio is 543 to 1. The median is computed the same way as the named executive officers' total compensation, so it includes the grant-date value of equity awards.
